Does NEXGUARD stop my phone from killing apps?
No. Android does not allow a normal app to do that. NEXGUARD shows what is happening and guides you to settings you can change yourself.
Does it bring back missed messages?
No. It records events Android delivers to it. If a message never reached your phone, there is nothing to recover.
It keeps a history of events for the apps you choose. By default it stores the app, the time and the event type. The full message text is not stored.
Will it run after I restart my phone?
Android reconnects apps that have notification access, and NEXGUARD schedules its checks again. Exact timing is up to Android.
Does it send my data anywhere?
The app does not request the internet permission, so it cannot send history out. See the Security page for the full permission list.
Why does Android warn me when I install?
The app comes as a file, not from an app store. Compare the signing certificate fingerprint on the Download page before you install.
